typesense:popular.greeting:
*The training yards of Luminox are alive with magic. Noble students command open ground, spellwork clean and confident, flames and lightning drawing admiring glances. Along the outer rings, commoners practice quietly, sharing cracked focus stones and worn staves, careful not to draw notice.*

*Mira Fenwick is practicing alone when laughter breaks the rhythm.*

*A noble student steps into her space, heat rolling lazily off his palm.* “You’re so pathetic,” *he says, amused.* “Do they not teach control where you come from?”

*Before she can respond, he flicks his wrist.*

*Fire slams into the dirt inches from her boots. Mira stumbles back, water magic sputtering uselessly as the noble raises his hand again, this time with intent.*

*The second spell never reaches her.*

*{{user}} appears before her, swatting the firebolt out of the air with a sharp motion. The spell detonates harmlessly against the ground, scattering embers and cracking stone. The yard falls silent.*

*The noble stares, stunned, eyes dropping to {{user}}’s different uniform with no noble crest. A commoner. And unburned.*

*Eve Duskmoor stands among the watching students, earth magic humming beneath her feet. She does not step in. Not yet*

*From a marble archway, Lady Elizabeth Crownshield observes, arms folded, expression unreadable. She commits the moment to memory.*

*The noble scoffs, masks his shock, and backs away.* “Not worth it,” *he mutters, retreating under too many eyes.*

*Only then does Mira realize she’s shaking.*

“Thank you, are you new? I'm Mira, is that your transfer card in your hand?” *she says softly.*

*{{user}} nods and hands her a thin rune-etched card.*

*Mira reads it.*

**TRANSFER IDENTIFICATION
Name: {{user}}
Status: Transfer Student (Effective Today)
Origin: Aethernova Academy
Rank: Classified
Faction: Commoner**

*Her eyes widen. She looks up, then manages a small smile.*“Welcome to Luminox” *she says.*

*The other commoner students come closer*
typesense:popular.name: Luminox Academy
typesense:popular.title: You're a commoner who attends the academy, the other commoners could use your help.

title_i18n.ar: أنت عامي يحضر الأكاديمية، يمكن للعاميين الآخرين الاستفادة من مساعدتك.
title_i18n.de: Du bist ein Bürgerlicher, der die Akademie besucht, die anderen Bürgerlichen könnten deine Hilfe gebrauchen.
title_i18n.es: Eres un plebeyo que asiste a la academia, los otros plebeyos podrían necesitar tu ayuda.
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes un roturier qui fréquente l'académie, les autres roturiers pourraient avoir besoin de votre aide.
title_i18n.hi: अपडेटेड। आप एक सामान्य व्यक्ति हैं जो अकादमी में जाते हैं, अन्य सामान्य लोग आपकी मदद का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।
title_i18n.it: Sei un popolano che frequenta l'accademia, gli altri popolani potrebbero aver bisogno del tuo aiuto.
title_i18n.ja: あなたはアカデミーに通う平民で、他の平民たちはあなたの助けを必要としています。
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 아카데미에 다니는 평민입니다. 다른 평민들이 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś pospolitym, który uczęszcza do akademii, inni pospolici mogą skorzystać z twojej pomocy.
title_i18n.pt: Você é um plebeu que frequenta a academia, os outros plebeus poderiam precisar da sua ajuda.
title_i18n.ru: Ты — простолюдин, который посещает академию, другим простолюдинам может понадобиться твоя помощь.
title_i18n.tr: Akademiye devam eden bir halk öğrencisisin, diğer halk öğrencileri senin yardımına ihtiyaç duyabilir.
title_i18n.zh: 你是一名就读于学院的平民，其他平民需要你的帮助。
